Nao T.: Quick sync request — GovPilot wants private deployment + KMS/HSM + strict p95 <120ms at 512 tokens. Need owners and blockers list. @Aria @Kris @Amy
Aria (eng-runtime): Feasible with pinned quantized model, batch_size=1, and prewarm. Will run perf tests.
Kris (eng-infra): GovCloud AMI approval + HSM entitlements are the main lead times. ETA ~5 business days after account info. Need capacity estimate from runtime.
Amy (sec): HSM requires signed key policy and SIEM integration. I'll circulate checklist. Need POC from customer.
Liam O.: I'll own canary toggle + automated rollback (feature-flag + alerting). Propose canary steps: 5% -> 30% -> 100% over 10 days.
Jessie K.: Product acceptance: rollback if error rate >1% OR p95 >150ms sustained 10m. Also need structured audit logs retained 1 year for this customer.
Aria (eng-runtime): Test plan (short): `smoke 2k reqs @ batch=1`, p50/p95/p99 for 128/256/512, with/without KV cache. ETA 48h.
Nao T.: Owners recap: Nao=customer comms, Aria=perf + builds, Kris=infra provisioning, Amy=security sign-off, Liam=rollout automation, Jessie=acceptance. First sync tomorrow 10am PT. I'll drop Opt-in contact here. Thanks!
